Determining Median of Classified Data: If the number of classified data is $n$, the value of $\frac{n}{2}$th term of classified data is median. And the formula used to determine the median or the value of $\frac{n}{2}$th term is : $\text{Median} = L + \left(\frac{n}{2} - F_c\right) \times \frac{h}{f_m}$, where $L$ is the lower limit of the median class, $n$ is the frequency, $F_c$ is the cumulative frequency of previous class to median class, $f_m$ is the frequency of median class and $h$ is the class interval.
